data.one_liner: iOS-style sidebars and floating tab bars for iPadOS navigation in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Brings iOS-style sidebars and floating tab bars to Flutter applications. It enables iPadOS-style navigation using widgets like CupertinoSidebar and CupertinoFloatingTabBar.
use_when: You are building an iPadOS-style layout in Flutter using Cupertino widgets.
You need a native-feeling sidebar or floating tab bar for app navigation.
avoid_when: You are using exclusively Material Design navigation components.
You need a complete ready-made adaptive scaffold that automatically switches layout types (not documented as fully built yet).
strengths: Supports expandable sections within the sidebar.
weaknesses: Limited to specific Cupertino navigation patterns.
Adaptive scaffold functionality is currently planned on the roadmap rather than fully detailed in the current version.
